Allow location so this app can show your live signal, cells, and Wi-Fi networks.\n\nAllowing location also lets the app share anonymous network-quality data with NTC. Nothing you see on screen is uploaded, and you can turn uploads off at any time in Settings.
Location permission is off for this app. Signal, Cells, and Wi-Fi need it.
